note: Provenance for every raster shipped with site/. Sources are the repository's own synthetic fixtures and the opt-in native capture harness; no customer site, external image or generative imagery is included. Screenshot pixels are displayed unmodified; the only per-file work is metadata stripping and, for thumbs/icons, the crop/resize recorded here.
